title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: How to easily check users and their licenses (User Details)
summary: User Details page provides a quick way to view all users and their assigned licenses in Business Central without needing to access the Users in Plans query or create customizations.
key_points: Access User Details by opening the Users page and selecting User Identifier Overview
User Details page displays user name, authentication email, Entra Object ID, and assigned licenses
Replaces the need to use Users in Plans query or build custom list pages for license tracking
Provides centralized view of user licensing information in one convenient location

quotes.text: Just open User Identifier Overview from the Users page.
quotes.why_it_matters: Provides the direct navigation path to access the new user and license viewing capability without customization
